title: Frontend catalog: inspiration, fonts, and approved libraries
maintenanceRule: A library or service SDK counts as maintained when it is not archived or deprecated and has an npm release or a default-branch commit within 12 months of verifiedAt. Fonts are judged by their distribution package, because a finished typeface needs no commits. Entries with no package and no public repository are judged by the live page alone, and say so in evidence.note.

entries.name: Navbar Gallery
entries.whenToUse: Choosing a navigation pattern for a marketing site or app shell: top bar, mega menu, mobile drawer, sticky behavior.
entries.avoidWhen: The project already has a navigation component; extend that instead.

entries.name: Footer
entries.whenToUse: Structuring a site footer: link columns, newsletter capture, legal row, how much to put in it.
entries.avoidWhen: In-app screens, which rarely need a marketing footer.

entries.name: Landbook
entries.whenToUse: Surveying whole landing pages by industry or style before fixing a page structure.
entries.avoidWhen: Deciding a single component; use the component-level entries instead.

evidence.note: curl receives 403 from a bot challenge; the page loaded in an isolated Orca browser profile on 2026-11-19 with the title 'Landbook - website design inspiration gallery'.

entries.name: SaaS Landing Page
entries.whenToUse: Landing pages for a software product: section order, proof, pricing placement, calls to action.
entries.avoidWhen: Non-software or editorial sites.

entries.name: Landingfolio
entries.whenToUse: Comparing how individual landing sections (pricing, testimonials, features, FAQ) are built across sites.
entries.avoidWhen: App UI work.

entries.name: Supahero
entries.whenToUse: Designing the hero section: headline, supporting line, primary action, and visual arrangement.
entries.avoidWhen: Pages with no hero, such as dashboards and settings.

entries.name: CTA.gallery
entries.whenToUse: Closing sections and inline calls to action on marketing pages.
entries.avoidWhen: In-app primary actions, which follow the app's own button hierarchy.

entries.name: Bento Grids
entries.whenToUse: Feature overviews or dashboards-as-marketing laid out as a bento grid.
entries.avoidWhen: Dense data screens; a bento grid trades information density for looks.

entries.name: Minimal Gallery
entries.whenToUse: Restrained, typography-led layouts for portfolios, studios, and editorial pages.
entries.avoidWhen: Feature-heavy product marketing that needs more structure than a minimal page gives.

entries.name: Dark Mode Design
entries.whenToUse: Designing a dark theme: surface layering, contrast, accent use.
entries.avoidWhen: Projects that ship light mode only.

entries.name: Mobbin
entries.whenToUse: Finding how shipped products design a specific app screen: onboarding, settings, empty states, billing.
entries.avoidWhen: Marketing pages. Full access needs a paid account, so cite the pattern, not a deep link.

entries.name: Refero
entries.whenToUse: Searching real web app screens by page type or element when Mobbin lacks the case.
entries.avoidWhen: Marketing pages. Full access needs a paid account.

entries.name: SaaSFrame
entries.whenToUse: Reference screens for common SaaS surfaces: dashboards, pricing pages, onboarding, transactional emails.
entries.avoidWhen: Consumer or content products.

entries.name: Page Flows
entries.whenToUse: Designing a multi-step flow (sign-up, checkout, upgrade, cancel) and deciding step order.
entries.avoidWhen: Single static screens. Full access needs a paid account.

entries.name: The Component Gallery
entries.whenToUse: Naming a component correctly and seeing how established design systems build it, including its accessibility notes.
entries.avoidWhen: Page-level layout decisions.

entries.name: The Shape of AI
entries.whenToUse: Choosing interaction patterns for AI features: prompts, streaming, citations, regeneration, human approval.
entries.avoidWhen: Interfaces with no AI behavior.

entries.name: Typewolf
entries.whenToUse: Picking a font pairing and seeing it used on real sites.
entries.avoidWhen: Choosing a font that is not in this catalog's font list; flag the gap instead.

entries.name: Fonts In Use
entries.whenToUse: Checking how a specific typeface from the font list behaves in real layouts.
entries.avoidWhen: Choosing a font that is not in this catalog's font list; flag the gap instead.

entries.name: Web Interface Guidelines (Vercel)
entries.whenToUse: Setting the quality bar for interaction details: focus, forms, loading, motion, touch targets.
entries.avoidWhen: Never; treat as the default checklist for any web UI, below the project's own conventions.

entries.name: ARIA Authoring Practices Guide patterns
entries.whenToUse: Specifying keyboard and screen-reader behavior for a custom widget: dialog, combobox, menu, tabs, listbox.
entries.avoidWhen: Native HTML elements already give the behavior; prefer the native element.

evidence.note: Returns 200 with the title 'Patterns | APG | WAI | W3C' to a plain curl request; a request with a browser user agent got a 403 bot challenge.

entries.name: Inter
entries.whenToUse: Default UI sans for dense product interfaces, tables, and forms.
entries.avoidWhen: A brand that needs a distinctive voice; Inter is neutral by design.

entries.name: Geist and Geist Mono
entries.whenToUse: A modern UI sans with a matching mono, for developer-facing products.
entries.avoidWhen: Long-form reading; pair with a serif from this list instead.

entries.name: IBM Plex Sans and Mono
entries.whenToUse: Technical or data products that want more character than Inter, with a matching mono.
entries.avoidWhen: Playful or consumer brands.

entries.name: JetBrains Mono
entries.whenToUse: Code blocks, terminals, and tabular figures.
entries.avoidWhen: Body text.

entries.name: Instrument Sans
entries.whenToUse: Marketing pages and headings that need a warmer sans than Inter.
entries.avoidWhen: Dense data tables.

entries.name: Instrument Serif
entries.whenToUse: Large display headlines on landing and editorial pages.
entries.avoidWhen: Body text or small sizes; it is a display face with one weight.

entries.name: Fraunces
entries.whenToUse: Expressive headings where the brand wants personality.
entries.avoidWhen: Neutral product UI.

entries.name: Source Serif 4
entries.whenToUse: Long-form reading: docs, articles, changelogs.
entries.avoidWhen: Compact UI labels.

entries.name: Newsreader
entries.whenToUse: Editorial layouts that want a news-style text and headline serif.
entries.avoidWhen: Compact UI labels.

entries.name: cmdk
entries.whenToUse: A command palette or keyboard-first searchable menu in a React app.
entries.avoidWhen: A plain select or autocomplete over a short fixed list; use the project's select or combobox.
entries.flagReason: Named by the owner, so kept. It fails the maintenance rule: latest release 2025-03-14 and last default-branch commit 2025-10-29, both more than 12 months before verifiedAt. Not archived. Pin the version, and re-check that it still works and is still maintained at every React upgrade.

entries.name: Beautiful UI
entries.whenToUse: AI-native surfaces: chat prompt bar, streaming text, thinking traces, tool chips, human approval cards, task rows.
entries.avoidWhen: Interfaces with no agent or chat behavior, or a project whose design system already has these parts.

evidence.note: Copy-paste component source, MIT per https://www.beautifului.dev/license (200). There is no npm package and no public repository, so maintenance cannot be judged by release or commit date; only the live page was verified.

entries.name: shadcn/ui
entries.whenToUse: Default component set for a new React and Tailwind project: buttons, dialogs, forms, tables, menus.
entries.avoidWhen: An existing project with its own component library; its components win.

entries.name: Astryx
entries.whenToUse: A new React 19+ app that needs a themed component system with prebuilt styles, design tokens, and dark mode.
entries.avoidWhen: The project already has a component system, uses React below 19, or requires a stable component API. Astryx is in beta.

evidence.note: Core requires react and react-dom >=19.0.0 and @stylexjs/stylex ^0.19.0. The Neutral theme requires the matching core version. This entry covers runtime packages. The official setup guide at https://astryx.atmeta.com/docs/getting-started also documents the development CLI.

entries.name: Radix Primitives
entries.whenToUse: An accessible unstyled primitive (dialog, popover, menu, tabs) that shadcn/ui does not already wrap.
entries.avoidWhen: The shadcn/ui component exists; add that instead of the raw primitive.

entries.name: React Aria Components
entries.whenToUse: Complex accessible widgets Radix does not cover well: date and time pickers, drag and drop lists, grid lists, internationalized inputs.
entries.avoidWhen: Simple overlays and menus already covered by shadcn/ui or Radix; do not mix two primitive systems for the same widget.

entries.name: Tailwind CSS
entries.whenToUse: Default styling for a new web project.
entries.avoidWhen: An existing project styled another way; follow its convention.

entries.name: Motion
entries.whenToUse: Layout, presence, gesture, or orchestrated animation that CSS transitions cannot express.
entries.avoidWhen: Simple hover, fade, or slide effects; use CSS transitions.

entries.name: Lucide
entries.whenToUse: Default icon set for interface icons.
entries.avoidWhen: Brand logos or illustration; a project that already ships another icon set.

entries.name: TanStack Query
entries.whenToUse: Client-side server state: caching, background refetch, optimistic mutations, pagination.
entries.avoidWhen: Data rendered on the server by the framework's own loader, or purely local UI state.

entries.name: TanStack Table
entries.whenToUse: Data tables that need sorting, filtering, column control, or pagination.
entries.avoidWhen: A static table with a handful of rows; use plain table markup.

entries.name: React Hook Form
entries.whenToUse: Forms with client-side validation, many fields, or field arrays.
entries.avoidWhen: A single input or a form fully handled by server actions without client validation.

entries.name: Zod
entries.whenToUse: Parsing and validating untrusted input at a boundary: forms, API payloads, environment, URL params.
entries.avoidWhen: A project already standardized on another schema library.

entries.name: Sonner
entries.whenToUse: Transient confirmations and non-blocking errors.
entries.avoidWhen: Errors the user must act on; show those inline next to the cause.

entries.name: Recharts
entries.whenToUse: Standard line, bar, area, and pie charts in a React app.
entries.avoidWhen: Very large series or custom visual forms that need canvas or a lower-level library; flag the gap.

entries.name: date-fns
entries.whenToUse: Date arithmetic and formatting beyond what Intl.DateTimeFormat covers.
entries.avoidWhen: Formatting a date for display only; use the platform Intl API.

entries.name: nuqs
entries.whenToUse: State that must survive reload and be shareable or capturable by URL: filters, tabs, pagination, open panels.
entries.avoidWhen: Ephemeral state such as hover or an unsaved draft.

entries.name: Zustand
entries.whenToUse: Client state shared across distant components that is not server state and not URL state.
entries.avoidWhen: State one component tree can own with useState or context; server data (use TanStack Query).

entries.name: AI SDK
entries.whenToUse: Streaming model output and chat state from a TypeScript backend to a React client.
entries.avoidWhen: A feature that makes one non-streaming model call on the server; call the provider SDK directly.

entries.name: Streamdown
entries.whenToUse: Rendering model output as Markdown while it streams, including incomplete blocks.
entries.avoidWhen: Static Markdown content known at build time.

entries.name: Base UI
entries.whenToUse: Building a React design system with unstyled, accessible dialogs, menus, popovers, and comboboxes.
entries.avoidWhen: The project's existing component system or primitives already cover the interaction.

entries.name: Vaul
entries.whenToUse: A React drawer or mobile bottom sheet with drag gestures and snap points.
entries.avoidWhen: An existing drawer meets the interaction requirements, or the project requires active upstream maintenance.
entries.flagReason: The maintainer explicitly marks Vaul unmaintained. The latest release was 2024-12-14 and the latest default-branch commit was 2025-10-03. Check compatibility before adopting it.

entries.name: input-otp
entries.whenToUse: A segmented React verification-code field that supports keyboard entry, paste, and autofill.
entries.avoidWhen: The project already has an OTP field or a single standard input meets the requirements.

entries.name: Leva
entries.whenToUse: An interactive React control panel for tuning animation values, visuals, or scene parameters.
entries.avoidWhen: A production settings form needs the project's standard fields and validation.
entries.flagReason: Fails the 12-month maintenance rule. The latest release was 2025-10-31 and the latest default-branch commit was 2025-11-08. Verify compatibility with the project's React version.

evidence.note: Repository and README verified through the GitHub API.

entries.name: NumberFlow
entries.whenToUse: Digit transitions for changing counters, prices, or statistics that need locale-aware number formatting.
entries.avoidWhen: A static value or an immediate numeric update meets the requirements.

entries.name: Torph
entries.whenToUse: Morphing between short changing text labels while preserving the letters that stay the same.
entries.avoidWhen: An immediate update or a simple fade is sufficient, or the text contains essential feedback that must stay immediately readable.

entries.name: COBE
entries.whenToUse: An interactive WebGL globe with location markers or arcs between locations.
entries.avoidWhen: A static illustration or list conveys the same information, or the app needs a navigable geographic map.

entries.name: Satori
entries.whenToUse: Generating dynamic Open Graph cards or share images from JSX and supported CSS, with SVG as the rendering output.
entries.avoidWhen: A static image or the framework's existing image generator suffices, or the layout needs full browser CSS support.

evidence.note: Repository and README verified through the GitHub API. Rendering PNG requires an additional SVG rasterizer or a framework image generator.

entries.name: Shiki
entries.whenToUse: Syntax highlighting for rendered code blocks in docs, Markdown, or an app, preferably at build time or on the server.
entries.avoidWhen: The documentation framework already provides highlighting or the project only needs plain monospace code.

entries.name: Liveline
entries.whenToUse: A scrolling React chart where new time-series points arrive continuously and need smooth live updates.
entries.avoidWhen: A chart shows historical data or refreshes occasionally. Use the project's general-purpose chart library.

evidence.note: Repository and README verified through the GitHub API.

entries.name: dnd kit
entries.whenToUse: React drag-and-drop across lists or drop targets, with keyboard interaction and configurable sensors.
entries.avoidWhen: The project's existing drag-and-drop system covers the case, or simple move controls meet the interaction requirements.
entries.flagReason: The current React API is pre-1.0 and differs from the legacy packages. Check API stability against the project requirements and consult the migration guide when extending a legacy integration.

evidence.note: The React quickstart uses @dnd-kit/react. Add @dnd-kit/helpers when the implementation uses utilities such as move for sortable lists.

entries.name: React Virtuoso
entries.whenToUse: Rendering long React lists, grids, or tables when mounting every item makes scrolling or interaction slow.
entries.avoidWhen: The list is short or the project already uses a suitable virtualizer.

evidence.note: This entry covers the MIT react-virtuoso package. The commercial Message List is a separate product.

entries.name: clsx
entries.whenToUse: Combining conditional CSS class names from several booleans, objects, or arrays.
entries.avoidWhen: A single conditional or an existing class-name utility is enough.
entries.flagReason: Fails the 12-month maintenance rule. The latest release and default-branch commit were on 2024-04-23.

evidence.note: Repository and README verified through the GitHub API.

entries.name: Class Variance Authority
entries.whenToUse: Defining typed class variants for reusable components with several dimensions such as size, intent, and state.
entries.avoidWhen: A component has only a simple conditional class or already uses the project's variant utility.

evidence.note: This entry uses the stable class-variance-authority package. The separately named cva package distributes the v1 beta under its beta tag.

entries.name: next-themes
entries.whenToUse: Persisting a React user's theme choice, following the system preference, and applying the chosen theme before paint in a Next.js app.
entries.avoidWhen: The app already has a theme provider or only needs a CSS system-preference media query.
entries.flagReason: Fails the 12-month maintenance rule. The latest release was 2025-03-11 and the latest default-branch commit was 2025-05-31. Verify hydration and theme switching against the project's React and Next.js versions.

evidence.note: Repository and README verified through the GitHub API.
